commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
She is guarded more closely and her desire has grown. She says this to her friend.

Desire doesn’t fear that women are too firm to be overcome, or pity them as deserving mercy. Even a woman’s desire gets past her hiding and shows in the open, before her father and brothers. Seeming to speak of women in general, she hints that her own desire has grown and that her love must now be made known.
